title: Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday The Senate Agriculture Committee will hear Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland on Tuesday, President Trump's bipartisan picks to join CFTC Chairman Michael Selig, currently the agency's only sitting commissioner. This post Senate Agriculture Committee to Hear Trump’s CFTC Nominees Tuesday first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
